newsitem.title: UK: Ford plans 40 mln stg investment at UK plant.
newsitem.headline: Ford plans 40 mln stg investment at UK plant.

text.p: U.S. car giant Ford Motor Co plans to make a 40 million stg investment at its Enfield plant in north London, a spokesman said on Thursday.

The cash will be spent on new production facilities for manufacturing of panels but hinges on Ford obtaining clearance from the local planning authorities. It also needs to purchase extra land for the expansion. No new jobs will be created by the investment.

Ian McAllister, chairman of Ford in the UK, said in a statement "This significant investment at our Enfield plant further demonstrates Ford's commitment to Britain and comes only weeks after we announced a 25 million pounds ($40.8 million) investment at our Swansea plant in South Wales."
He added that Ford had spent more than 3.5 billion pounds in the UK over the last five years.
The Enfield plant extension should begin to be built later this year, with its first output of panels seen in 1999.
The plant currently supplies components to Ford plants in the UK, continental Europe, the U.S. and Mexico.
